data.content:
* * *

## [Wayfair has better customer experience and delivery](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65f486c48a46d52025b14384)

If you plan on buying a lamp or vase, this company might be fine, but after spending $7K on furniture, the customer service and quality of furniture are extremely frustrating. My designer picked out an ottoman and couch from Lulu and bought them per the recommendation. Here was my experience.

The ottoman came quickly but was in a box completely un-padded/secured. Literally, thrown in a box with some plastic wrap. The $800 ottoman was left outside our city apartment building. A plastic piece on the interior of the ottoman was broken, but whatever. I moved on.

The couch - We were originally quoted 5-7 weeks for the couch. A few weeks after placing the order we realized the measurements were off and we might want a different couch. There is NO one to call or speak with. Via email, they say if the couch hasn't started being built, we can cancel. Finally hear back and they tell us we can't cancel. "Fine I say, does that mean it will be here soon/er?". Lulu, "No, the couch will still be an additional 6 weeks." I was pissed, but my fault for not checking the policies.

The cherry on top - I go to the website and see the couch is now 25% off. I reached out and asked if they could honor that discount given my couch is still over a month out from being delivered. No - they will not honor the sale. In summary, I am paying $6k for a couch that will take over 8 weeks to receive, doesn't fit well in my space, and is now discounted to $5K.

February 12, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 16, 2024

Hi Natasha, Thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear about your experience with us. We're truly grateful for your feedback and understand your concerns regarding our customer service accessibility, our shipping service, and our price adjustment policies. As noted on the product page, the ottoman is delivered curbside delivery only and not white glove. We're sorry for the trouble. As for the made to order sofa, unfortunately, we're unable to guarantee cancellations once they have been submitted as it is instantly sent to our distribution warehouse for processing. We want to clarify that we honor price adjustments for full-priced items if they go on sale within 7 days of your purchase, provided no other offers were applied. These adjustments are issued as store credit for the difference, excluding taxes. Please note that we can't combine promotional offers, including site-wide and shipping discounts. Our Customer Experience team made an exception to our policies, and honored the price adjustment for your order in the form of store credit.

Your input is invaluable, and we'll certainly consider it as we strive to improve our services. We are available on Live Chat Monday-Friday 9am-5pm PST and we also offer scheduled phone call backs, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
